factory_fit.mission: Removes a preventable human and runtime safety ambiguity before a bounded provider read.
factory_fit.flexibility: Keeps the route, collector shape and retention boundary narrow; no scheduler, database, adapter platform or provider selection is introduced.
factory_fit.research_truth: Synthetic responses and technical receipts cannot become PIT, H07/H01, trial, execution or cashflow evidence.
factory_fit.owner_operability: One exact future phrase binds two UTC slots, one foreground monitoring owner and the eight-GET total cap.
factory_fit.recovery: Late start, receipt-chain corruption, monitoring loss, unsafe transport and typed gaps fail closed without retry or fallback.
factory_fit.build_vs_buy: The narrow standard-library harness wraps only the already observed public route; no dependency or generic platform was added.
factory_fit.red_team: Tests reject malformed authority, a forged receipt chain, late offsets, invalid intervals, transport failure and unsafe CLI execution.

product_horizon_radar.now: A future owner gate can safely authorise one exact two-slot technical shakedown without expanding into a 24-hour collector.
product_horizon_radar.watch_trigger: If the shakedown emits an inconclusive or unsafe receipt, close this route and revisit reuse-first before considering a recurring capture.

project_sources_disposition.reason: A11C is an offline runtime harness and does not change canonical Project Sources or activation state.
